final_truth: The Taj Mahal, a stunning white marble mausoleum, is located in Agra, India. Built by Emperor Shah Jahan in 1653, it symbolizes eternal love. Visit at sunrise or sunset for the best views. Entry fees apply, and photography is allowed outside the main dome. A UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, it's a must-see for all travelers.
